title: Prepare a copy of personal data
confirm: I have verified this person and the approved scope of this request.
omit: Remove this text from the copy
reviewed: I have reviewed the exact data and removed other people's private information.
acknowledge: I understand that this copy does not complete the full request.
revokeConfirm: Stop future downloads; copies already downloaded cannot be recalled.
pending: The result is still being checked. Check the same request before trying again.
unavailable: This copy is unavailable. Return to the request for help.
saved: Change recorded. Review the current result below.
error: The change was not confirmed. Review the current data; if someone changed it, collect a fresh draft.
supplementConfirm: This is a reviewed redacted copy for this exact recipient and request; it excludes the original and other people’s private data.
